text.p: Nextel Communications Inc said on Monday it has closed on a $1.655 billion bank financing for expansion of the company's wireless network.

Funds will be used to finance the U.S. expansion of Nextel's integrated wireless communications network which enables customers access to a combination of digital cellular, two-way instant conferencing and paging in one handset, Nextel said.

The $1.655 billion senior secured bank credit facility is divided into a $1.085 billion revolving loan, a $250 million term loan, and a $320 million term loan for institutional investors, the company said.
The credit facility includes more than 30 lending institutions and was arranged by Chase Securities Inc, J.P. Morgan Securities Inc, and Toronto-Dominion Securities (USA) Inc, the company said.

Terms of these new financing arrangements, combined with currently outstanding or committed vendor financing from Motorola Inc and NTFC Financial Corp, provide Nextel with more than $2 billion of available capital, Nextel said.
